# Synthetic regression fixtures

These thirteen JSON files are curated regression snapshots from the NHI pulley demonstration's local development checks. They contain fictional example data, not customer records or original customer communications.

The contact identity, commercial terms, engineering questions and replies are synthetic. Attachments are copies of the explicitly labeled demo application sketch: a schematic without manufacturing dimensions or fit approval. Reserved `.example` email addresses are used. The files preserve historical test states so immutable-record, navigation, review and version-lineage checks remain reproducible.

The source files were reviewed for contact data, free text and attachment content before inclusion. Copies are byte-identical to the reviewed snapshots; fixture filenames record the originating development round. Historical screenshots, browser exports beyond this allowlist and private working notes are not part of this fixture set.
